watches.name: MHD TYPE 3 SAMPLE
watches.description: WATCH FEATURES : CASE Limited Edition of 100 4-piece layered exoskeleton chassis case design made 316l Stainless steel Black DLC (diamond like carbon) coating on barrel 40mm diameter by 11.5mm depth, 47mm Lug to Lug length knurled, brushed and chrome finishes applied to the case Sapphire crystal glass with bevel edge and AR coating Sapphire crystal exhibition case back and AR coating Water resistance to 5 ATM DIAL Steel finished chapter ring with black markings Blue colour dial with laser-cut marker slots Lower dial markings in white Super Luminova Date Window Power reserve sub dial Chrome power reserve hand Chrome precision hands with white Super Luminova (glows in the dark) Red second hand MOVEMENT Japanese Miyota 9130 Automatic 24 jewel mechanical movement 42-hour power reserve Hacking function stops the second hand for more precision when setting the time 2-year warranty on complete watch STRAP The watch comes with two straps Brown Italian calf leather rally strap with contrasting white stitching Blue Italian calf leather rally strap with contrasting white stitching THE BACKSTORY : MHD's Designer Matthew Humphries, has always been obsessed by motoring and especially what he considers to be the golden age of motoring, the 1920's! A period of high innovation, where motoring was truly established, designs were unrestricted and not held back by regulations, and for the first time people were starting to use cars for sport, as well as for essential travel. Some iconic Cars of the period such as the 3 litre Bentley, Bugatti type 35 and Zagato bodied Alfa Romeo 8c to name a few, are of great inspiration to Matthew and to celebrate 100 years since' the roaring 20's', he has designed a new watch range that takes influence from these vehicles, exposing their engineering details, with the second watch release being the MHD Type 3. IT STARTED WITH A SKETCH : One cold April morning, Matthew found himself at Prescott Speed Hill Climb watching a rather amazing selection of vintage Bugattis race up the hill. He found 5 minutes to get his sketch book out whilst in the moment, and noted down some ideas to influence our next watch design. All Vintage cars of the 20's expose their engineering and this is what inspired our outer chassis case design for the Type 1.

watches.name: MHD SQ1
watches.description: Watch Spec: Edition Limited edition of 300 marked on Case back 2 year warranty 14 day exchange or returns policy Orders will be dispatched within 1-3 working days of placing an order. Case Brushed finish 316 L Stainless steel case. 316 L Stainless steel case back with "limited edition of 300" marking. Knurled Crown, with screw down fixing. (at 4 o'clock to aid comfort) Case size 42mm, 11mm deep, 50mm Lug to Lug length. Bevel edged mineral crystal glass. 10 atm water resistance. Dial Satin finish black dial with red and grey markings. Black hands with luminous tips (glow in the dark). Red second hand. Movement Japanese Miyota 2035 quartz movement. Strap 20mm black calf leather rally strap with red stitching. Delivery Free world wide Delivery Finance To pay for your order on finance please select the Payl8r Button at the checkout stage, select your finance package and deposit where you will be taken through the application process. Your Daily Driver Watch Designed in house by Matthew Humphries (Car Designer of the Morgan Aeromax , Morgan 3 wheeler and other vehicles ) and the first of the MHD’s quartz watch collection is the 60’s inspired automotive themed MHDSQ1 watch, limited to an edition of 300, Motorsports Watch. The MHDSQ1 captures the style and case shape of 60’s & 70’s watches, whilst the dial takes influence from the cars of the same period, in particular the “in the red zone” of the rev counters in classic Porsche 911 VDO car dials. MHD have always admired the period for its experimentation, especially in motoring watches and has tried to capture this within the MHDSQ1 through: the bold manufactured look of the stainless steel watch case shape, the functional screw down crown with knurled edge finish, to the brightly coloured dial and pairing it with an iconic leather rally strap that is so reminiscent of the time.

The MHD SA2 uses an engineered design aesthetic to capture the quality of these cars and produces a motorsport engineered timepiece. The MHDSA2 has an exoskeleton chassis case, designed with solid bars (no spring bars) for strength and simplicity, which makes for fast and efficient strap changes. Exposing its engineering, the SA2 includes other motorsport features and finishes such as the black DLC coated knurled watch barrel and machine turned knurled crown, which is held in place by allen head fixings. The machine turned bezel then holds the Sapphire crystal glass in place. The dial consists of three components; from the black DLC chapter ring with yellow markers, to the machine-turned black colour sunray dial with laser cut markers, which is then layered over a lower super luminova dial for extra visibility in the dark. The semi-skeletonised hands also have additional super luminova. In keeping with excellent timing, the SA2 houses a Miyota 9039 automatic 24-jewel movement, which is known for its hacking function for precise time setting and 42-hour power reserve. The beautiful Miyota 9039 movement can be viewed from the sapphire crystal exhibition case back, which is also externally engraved with “MHD SA2”. For that added extra touch of motorsport, the SA2 is supplied with two soft, but strong car seat belt material nato straps, one in grey and the other black with a yellow racing stripe, which can be swapped out in seconds!

Designed by British car and watch designer Matthew Humphries, the AGT Automatic Timepiece focuses on automotive design processes and was conceived by Humphries whilst designing the Alcraft GT electric high-performance vehicle for the founder of Alcraft Motor Company, David Alcraft. The AGT Watch and Alcraft GT car are a natural pairing, both products seeking to blend the ultra clean and contemporary with the timeless values of British design. The design language of the AGT echoes that of the Alcraft GT concept vehicle, with every element designed for purpose as well as aesthetic. The Alcraft GT for example has an exposed carbon-fibre B-pillar and roof structure which are very much part of the aesthetic but also serve as both a safety structure and a device to create an exceptionally light cabin, allowing a roof made largely of glass and a wraparound front screen. The AGT timepiece has similar exposed elements, influenced by the Alcraft GT’s internal skeletonised carbon-fibre structure. In particular this can be seen in the AGT’s exoskeleton lug design chassis and centre barrel case, reducing the weight of the watch whilst protecting the automatic movement inside. The AGT timepiece has a 42mm diameter, four-piece layered stainless steel, lightweight, exoskeleton case, which is 12.5mm in depth and topped with resilient, scratch-resistant sapphire crystal bevel-edged glass. The crown and case layers are highlighted with beautiful automotive-style knurled and polished chamfered-edge finishes. The AGT houses a Miyota 9015 automatic 24-jewel movement, which is known for its hacking function for precise time setting and 42-hour power reserve. watches.name: MHD CR1, White dial
watches.description: Your Rally /Racing Chronograph: Designed in the uk by British Car designer Matthew Humphries, the CR1 is a 60’s inspired, automotive themed, Chrono quartz timepiece, and limited to an edition of 500. The MHDCR1 captures the style of 60‘s / 70’s motoring watches, with it’s bold industrial stainless steel case, screw down knurled edge crown and paired with the infamous leather rally strap adorned by many a race driver. Drawing on Humphries’ Car design background & style, the CR1 ties to the automotive industry through its classic design cues in vehicle gauges. The CR1 shifts into a modern, functional watch, with its chrono movement synonymous with motor racing, cut-out minute & hour hands for constant visibility of sub dials, and an unusual extra long second hand, which allows the rally enthusiast to easily count every second, whilst reading the tulip road book. One way or another, the MHDCR1 has something to please the classic and modern motor enthusiast. If you’re anything like Humphries and have a passion for classic car rallying, this is a great choice for a Motorsports Watch.
